Message:
This year’s card has
an unfamiliar handwriting, too.
Father must have been so busy,
he needed to ask
another attendant to write it,
I’m sure.

And, from Mother...
I’m sure she simply
had no time to respond
to my last letter.

There’s no letter from
my little sister, either.
I wrote for her to send me one,
but it must have
slipped her mind.
She can be so forgetful!

For my birthday present,
they sent me a pet bird,
just like every year.
Hehe, it’s simply adorable.

I can only hope
this one lives longer
than the others...

Since I’m living alone in this
vacation estate until I get better,

they’ve always sent me birds
to keep me company...

“How long will it take
before you wake up
to all of their lies?”

They aren’t lying...!
When I get better,
my parents will come
to take me back home.
They promised.

All of this is just proof of
how much they love me...!
